$comment: status: RATIFIED spec.v1 (G3, Jason, 2026-07-30) — candidate replay.v1 corpus replay, acceptance-gate, and backstop-parity schema; not operator-ratified
title: Spec Corpus Replay Contract
description: Operator-signed semantic replay maps, revised gates 1–7, real-consumer probe fixtures, and two-layer full-context-backstop parity records.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS of this replay artifact with only manifest_sha256 omitted.

x-acceptance-gates.name: baseline_inventory
x-acceptance-gates.pass: Exactly 71 unique Concerns; verdict counts are 62 accept, 8 acknowledge, 1 dismiss.

x-acceptance-gates.name: signed_mapping_completeness
x-acceptance-gates.pass: Every Concern has an operator-signed mapped record or explicit signed acknowledged/dismissed out-of-scope disposition; silent_drops=0.

x-acceptance-gates.name: guardrail_preservation
x-acceptance-gates.pass: All 16 CONS, 11 CANON, and 36 TCOV targets are represented.

x-acceptance-gates.name: authority_preservation
x-acceptance-gates.pass: Exact normative body hashes and all import precedence, amendment, and supersession edges are preserved.

x-acceptance-gates.name: per_bundle_co_visibility
x-acceptance-gates.pass: For every Concern, one designated verified seat bundle records required_set subset-of visible_set and missing_set is empty; visible_set is derived exclusively from verified spec_slice components, including recursive descendants, and non-spec components are ineligible. The declared full bundle satisfies all 71 target sets. Union across bundles or slices is forbidden.

x-acceptance-gates.name: verify_bundle_determinism
x-acceptance-gates.pass: spec verify-bundle passes and exact component, manifest, and final bundle hashes are identical across at least three independent runs.

x-acceptance-gates.name: real_fizzy_consumer_contract
x-acceptance-gates.pass: The named consumer test imports and executes fizzy_pipeline_mcp.pipeline.validate_gauntlet_probes over valid/mutant fixtures and matches expected violation codes; replay-corpus does not mirror the validator.

x-replay-authority-rules: Concern-to-target/evidence mapping and acknowledged/dismissed correctness require operator signatures.
Signatures cover RFC 8785 JCS of each record with only signature omitted.
All counts, set differences, hashes, and signature payloads are re-derived.
required_target_ids is the canonical union of mapped claim IDs, re-derived synthetic relation IDs, and evidence IDs; arbitrary or non-spec target additions are invalid.
Each synthetic relation target ID is relation: plus lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8 RFC 8785 JCS for the exact [source,type,target] string array.

Gate 5 is evaluated against one verified bundle per check using only target IDs re-derived from verified spec_slice components (direct or recursive descendants); non-spec components and set union across bundle IDs are invalid.
Gate 7 evidence is produced by the Fizzy consumer repository using the real callable; this replay artifact only pins and checks its receipt.

x-derived-rules: concern_total equals replay_maps length and unique concern_id count.

relation_target_id.description: Exactly relation: plus lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8 RFC 8785 JCS for the exact [source,type,target] string array, with no bytes outside the JCS value.

required_target_ids.description: Re-derived canonical union of required_claim_ids, every required_relations[*].relation_target_id, and required_evidence_refs. Arbitrary and non-spec additions are forbidden.

ConcernReplayMap.x-signed-payload: RFC 8785 JCS of this object with only signature omitted
ConcernReplayMap.x-derived-target-rule: required_target_ids equals the canonical set union of required_claim_ids, re-derived required_relations[*].relation_target_id, and required_evidence_refs.

GuardrailTargetMap.x-signed-payload: RFC 8785 JCS of this object with only signature omitted

AuthorityExpectations.x-lint-rule: Every amendment_edges item has type=amends and every supersession_edges item has type=supersedes.

visibility_basis.description: The visible set is re-derived exclusively from direct or recursively nested verified spec_slice components of seat_bundle_id; non-spec components are ineligible.

visible_target_ids.description: Must equal the designated verified bundle manifest's spec-slice-only visible_target_ids; never copied from non-spec metadata or unioned across bundles.

BundleVisibilityCheck.x-derived-rule: visible_target_ids equals the verified spec-slice-only visible set for this one seat_bundle_id, and missing_target_ids equals required_target_ids minus that visible_target_ids set.

BundleDeterminism.x-pass-rule: At least three independent runs, every verify_bundle_passed=true, and manifest/component/bundle hashes plus byte length are identical.

ProbeViolationCode.description: Stable fixture expectation labels. Fizzy owns validator behavior; the consumer contract test maps real returned violations to these fixture labels without reimplementing validity logic.

ConsumerContractTest.x-boundary: This test must import and run the real Fizzy callable. A shared-library or adversarial-spec mirror of validator logic is forbidden.

x-pass-rules: Gate 1 pass requires baseline constants and unique IDs.
Gate 2 pass requires mapped + explicit_out_of_scope = inventory concern_total and silent_drops = 0.
Gate 3 pass requires preserved counts equal inventory guardrail counts.
Gate 4 pass requires every mismatch array empty.
Gate 5 pass requires visibility_basis=verified_spec_slice_components_only, every check passed, failed_checks = 0, and each declared full bundle satisfies every required target set.
Gate 6 pass requires at least three runs, all real verify-bundle executions passing, and all exact hashes identical.
Gate 7 pass requires consumer_contract_test.result=pass from the named real Fizzy callable.

MechanicalRecall.x-derived-pass-rule: co_visible_target_sets / signed_target_sets = recall; pass requires recall=1 and missing_target_sets=0.

SignedAdjudicationCoverage.x-derived-pass-rule: signed_adjudications / baseline_concerns = coverage; pass requires coverage=1, degraded=0, and unadjudicated=0. Operators decide re_found/stronger/accounted semantics.

BackstopParity.x-retirement-rule: Approval requires at least two distinct independent corpora, both metric layers passing on each, and an explicit operator decision. Schema cannot judge corpus representativeness or semantic equivalence.
